# agyn_network (Resource)

Manages an Agyn private network.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Private network name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier for the private network.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the private network.
- `provisioning_state` (String) OpenZiti provisioning state for the private network.
